'''Fallaxen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who participated in the [[Grand Acquisitions Race]] held by the [[Chevin Conglomerate]], but was [[Death/Legends|killed]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].

==Behind the scenes==
Fallaxen appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an enemy in the Imperial mission "A Questionable Motive," part of the Grand Acquisitions Race World Event. The event was only held for a limited time, and has not been repeated since.
